regionWideBasis: Item description: Canada Lands Digital Cadastral Data 'covers Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut' (plus reserves, parks) as a seamless parcel feature service. GNWT's own Land Authority ATLAS layer requires a token. Only Yellowknife was sampled; coverage of Commissioner's land and municipal lots was not checked.

NRCan Canada Lands parcel aggregate; open.

remainingUncertainty: This is the federal Canada Lands cadastre, which in NT covers federal lands only if the description is read narrowly; density elsewhere untested. Territorial titles registry parcels not verified.
